parent_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
escalation_process: File complaint on Rajmargyatra portal → wait 30 days → escalate to MoRTH grievance portal → wait 30 days → approach National Highways Tribunal
text: NHAI National Highways Authority of India manages all National Highways NH roads in India, helpline 1033, complaint portal Rajmargyatra at rajmargyatra.nhai.org, email grievances@nhai.org, headquarters New Delhi, under Ministry of Road Transport MoRTH, response within 30 days, regional offices in Hyderabad Chennai Mumbai Delhi Bengaluru Kolkata, escalate to MoRTH if unresolved in 30 days

body_name: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
text: MoRTH Ministry of Road Transport and Highways is the apex body for road policy in India, handles escalated complaints from NHAI, complaint portal pgportal.gov.in, helpline 1800-180-3751, email morth@gov.in, escalation authority above NHAI, response within 60 days

jurisdiction: State Highways and Major District Roads in Telangana
text: Telangana Roads and Buildings Department manages State Highways SH and Major District Roads MDR in Telangana state, helpline 040-24651100, email ce.rb@telangana.gov.in, portal rb.telangana.gov.in, district offices in Hyderabad Rangareddy Medchal Warangal Nizamabad Karimnagar, response within 45 days, escalate to Chief Engineer R&B

jurisdiction: City roads within Hyderabad city limits
text: GHMC Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation manages all city roads within Hyderabad city limits, helpline 040-21111111, WhatsApp complaints 9849905588, email commissioner@ghmc.gov.in, portal ghmc.gov.in, zones LB Nagar Serilingampally Kukatpally Secunderabad Charminar Khairatabad, fastest response 21 days, best for potholes in Hyderabad city

body_name: NRIDA — National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency
app: Meri Sadak (available on Play Store and App Store)
text: NRIDA National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency manages PMGSY Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana rural village roads, complaint via Meri Sadak app on Play Store or App Store, portal omms.nic.in, email helpdesk@pmgsy.nic.in, response within 60 days, for roads connecting villages built under PMGSY scheme

jurisdiction: State Highways and MDR in Karnataka
text: Karnataka PWD Public Works Department manages State Highways and MDR roads in Karnataka, helpline 080-22032070, email ce.pwd@karnataka.gov.in, response 45 days

jurisdiction: City roads within Bengaluru city limits
text: BBMP Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike manages city roads within Bengaluru city limits, helpline 080-22660000, complaint portal bbmpsahaaya.karnataka.gov.in, email commissioner@bbmp.gov.in, response 21 days

jurisdiction: State Highways and MDR in Maharashtra
text: Maharashtra PWD manages State Highways and MDR in Maharashtra, helpline 022-22024713, portal mahaonline.gov.in, email secy.pwd@maharashtra.gov.in, response 45 days

jurisdiction: City roads within Mumbai city limits
text: BMC Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation manages city roads in Mumbai, helpline 1916, portal portal.mcgm.gov.in, email commissioner@mcgm.gov.in, response 21 days, for potholes in Mumbai city contact BMC

jurisdiction: State Highways and MDR in Tamil Nadu
text: Tamil Nadu Highways Department manages State Highways and MDR in Tamil Nadu, helpline 044-28270101, portal highways.tn.gov.in, email ce.highways@tn.gov.in, response 45 days

rule: If road name contains NH or National Highway → NHAI → helpline 1033 → rajmargyatra.nhai.org
text: National Highway NH roads are managed by NHAI, any road named NH-44 NH-65 NH-48 or similar is a National Highway under NHAI jurisdiction, file complaint at 1033 or rajmargyatra.nhai.org

rule: If road name contains SH or State Highway → State PWD of that state
text: State Highway SH roads are managed by the State PWD of whichever state the road is in, Telangana SH roads go to Telangana R&B, Karnataka SH roads go to Karnataka PWD, Maharashtra SH roads go to Maharashtra PWD

rule: If road is inside city limits → Municipal Corporation
text: City roads inside city limits are managed by Municipal Corporations, Hyderabad city roads go to GHMC, Bengaluru city roads go to BBMP, Mumbai city roads go to BMC, Chennai city roads go to GCC Greater Chennai Corporation

rule: If road is MDR Major District Road → District Collector then State PWD
text: Major District Roads MDR are managed by the District Collector office first, escalate to State PWD Regional Office if not resolved in 30 days, file at pgportal.gov.in

scenario: NHAI not responding to NH complaint
steps: Step 1: File on Rajmargyatra portal and note complaint number
Step 2: Wait 30 days — if unresolved escalate to MoRTH at pgportal.gov.in
Step 3: File RTI (Right to Information) request asking about complaint status
Step 4: Approach National Highways Tribunal if life safety is involved
Step 5: File petition in High Court if accident occurred due to pothole
text: If NHAI does not respond to National Highway NH complaint within 30 days, escalate to MoRTH Ministry of Road Transport at pgportal.gov.in, then file RTI Right to Information request, then approach National Highways Tribunal, High Court petition if accident occurred due to pothole negligence

scenario: General complaint escalation for any road
steps: Step 1: File complaint with primary authority (NHAI/PWD/Corporation)
Step 2: If no response in SLA period, file on pgportal.gov.in (Central Grievance Portal)
Step 3: File RTI to get repair timeline and budget information
Step 4: Contact local elected representative (MLA/MP) office
Step 5: Approach State Human Rights Commission if injury occurred
text: General escalation process for road complaints: first contact primary authority NHAI PWD or Corporation, if no response escalate to pgportal.gov.in central grievance portal, then file RTI, contact local MLA or MP office, approach State Human Rights Commission if injury occurred due to road negligence
